correctness.rationale: The displayed cover relation is independently matched to the self-contained description of \(P(9)\) in arXiv:2609.39615v1. The finite-space criterion that contractibility is equivalent to reduction to one point by beat-point deletions is stated there with the standard Stong reference. The verifier enumerates all \(2^9=512\) subsets, finds exactly 27 lower sets, recursively explores valid beat deletions, obtains exactly 11 nonempty contractible opens, exactly two inclusion-maximal ones, and exactly one unordered covering pair. It also checks that the full nine-point space has no beat point. No infinite conclusion is inferred from finite testing.

value.rationale: The object is the minimum-cardinality finite weakly contractible noncontractible example, and geometric category is specifically designed to retain finite-space structure that weak homotopy type loses. Classifying all maximal contractible opens is a natural complete finite invariant of its covering geometry, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The uniqueness result identifies a rigid geometric cover and supplies an exact benchmark for the covering algorithms introduced in later finite-space LS-category work.
